Simultaneously  pushing  the  Master  System  Control  Pad’s  2  buttons  and  the  Direction

notes: Source: Sega Master System instruction manual (model 1), Canadian edition distributed by Irwin (archive.org item SegaMasterSystemInstructionsManualIRWINImages), «Secret Feature» paragraph naming the Control Pad's «2 buttons and the Direction Controller». Quotes are verbatim lines of archive.org's OCR text (the item's _djvu.txt) of the maker's scanned manual, OCR errors and spacing included; the scan, not the OCR, is the authority, and a human should re-read each line against the page image. Mapping: Direction Controller = dpad 1; the 2 buttons (Button 1 / Button 2) = face_button 2; the sentence is the manual's only description of the pad, read as its complete control list (the pad has no Start or Pause button; Pause and Reset are on the console). Body dimensions, mass, cable length, wired/cord facts: no maker or museum figure found, null. Sega's own history archive (sega.jp/history/hard/…) returns 403 to automated fetches and was not retried; a human browser visit is listed in the lane report. The Master System II pad is a different moulding and is not covered here.
